label: The external-XOR LFSR
subgoals: XOR the tapped stages for the feedback bit
Load the feedback into the first stage
Shift every other stage one place along

label: The MISR
subgoals: Shift the register with feedback on each clock
XOR the response word into the stages
Repeat for every word and read the final signature

label: Polynomials over GF(2)
subgoals: Write the characteristic polynomial from the taps
Treat states as powers of x modulo the polynomial
Read a single-input signature as the remainder of polynomial division
